title: GSPC Benchmark - 13 governance axes
subtitle: JSONL measurement banks for 13 AI governance and safety axes
description:
# GSPC Benchmark Suite

Statute- and standard-anchored measurement banks for 13 AI governance/safety axes, published by CSOAI (Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence). JSONL: one item per line with text + expected label.

## Axes
governance (EU AI Act tiering) - care/safeguarding - safety refusal - detector interop (C2PA) - affect (manipulation/sycophancy) - provenance - cross-reality - machinery (Reg 2023/1230) - openness (licence) - continuity (PQC agility) - conformance (MCP/A2A) - Article 5 - counter-bank (held-out governance) + per-axis banks.

## Run
Tasks for EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness + UK AISI Inspect: github.com/CSOAI-ORG/gspc-benchmark (upstream PRs #4527, #2824). HF: huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-benchmark-suite

Live signed board: councilof.ai/api/gspc - 34 axes, all measured.

Measurement, not certification. CC-BY-4.0.

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 1, last updated 2026-11-08.
- 12 files, 92,432 bytes. File types: .jsonl (12).
- Related Hugging Face repository: [csoai/gspc-benchmark-suite](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-benchmark-suite). No byte-identical files were found, so treat it as related, not a mirror.
- Expected update frequency: never.
